title: Auto-Formalizing Neuro-Symbolic Predictors
abstract: arXiv:2610.01519v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neuro-Symbolic (NeSy) predictors incorporate prior knowledge into the prediction process of neural networks, ensuring that outputs satisfy specified constraints, making them particularly suitable for high-stakes applications where compliance with domain knowledge is essential. A key bottleneck in this paradigm is the acquisition of symbolic constraints: encoding domain knowledge into logical formulas remains a manual and expert-intensive process. In this work, we investigate the extent to which auto-formalization via LLMs can systematically translate textual knowledge into symbolic knowledge that can be plugged into NeSy predictors. To this end, we introduce auto-nesy-bench, a new benchmark for evaluating constraint formalization and its impact on downstream accuracy of NeSy predictors. translated_title: 自动形式化的神经符号预测器
translated_abstract: 神经符号预测器将先验知识融入神经网络的预测过程中，确保输出满足指定的约束条件，因此特别适合于必须遵循领域知识的高风险应用场景。该范式的一个关键瓶颈在于符号约束的获取：将领域知识编码为逻辑公式仍然是一个依赖专家、高度人工化的过程。在这项工作中，我们研究了通过大语言模型进行自动形式化，能在多大程度上系统地将文本知识转化为可直接嵌入神经符号预测器的符号知识。为此，我们提出了auto-nesy-bench，一个用于评估约束形式化质量及其对神经符号预测器下游准确性影响的新基准。通过对多个领域的广泛评估，我们发现大语言模型能够在相当程度上有意义地形式化约束，生成可用于提升预测性能的逻辑公式。
tldr: 该论文提出了auto-nesy-bench新基准，系统评估了大语言模型将文本领域知识自动形式化为逻辑约束的能力，并证明这些自动生成的约束能有效嵌入神经符号预测器以提升下游预测准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces auto-nesy-bench, a new benchmark for systematically evaluating LLMs' ability to auto-formalize textual domain knowledge into logical constraints, demonstrating that these automatically generated constraints can be effectively plugged into Neuro-Symbolic predictors to improve downstream prediction accuracy.
